## Appearance

Margaret has gentle, light brown locks and pixie-like features on a small, fair, and lovely visage. She also possesses long, thin, dark fingers.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015)_

## History

Margaret, a girl raised on the coast, was a writer who had a story published in [Canadian](../codex/places.md#canadian) Woman the previous winter while attending [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). She became the subject of a lost Margaret tale that [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) incorporated into Captain Saul's life story over the summer. Her story was part of the completed book delivered to Captain Saul shortly before his death.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P46](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018), +4 more_
